title: Houston Botanic Garden

services.name: Tasting Lounge ticket
services.desc: Take your festival experience to the next level with exclusive access to our Tasting Lounge, the perfect place to peel away from the crowd and relax! Enjoy festival admission, then cool off in our climate-controlled lounge tent while sampling tasty food prepared by local chef Mars Wasterval of Earth to Mars. You’ll also sip on complimentary fruit drinks and take home a commemorative Garden logo cup as a sweet souvenir. It’s the ultimate spot to unwind, recharge, and go absolutely bananas! Tasting Lounge tickets - which include admission to the festival and commemorative cup - are $45/adult, $41/child/student/senior/military. services.name: Field Trips
services.desc: The Houston Botanic Garden offers student groups from primary and secondary schools with field trip experiences that bring lessons from the classroom to life outdoors. Youth programming at the Garden is designed to encourage participating students to develop a deeper appreciation for plants and nature that, in turn, inspires them to be better environmental stewards. Fill out the Field Trip Inquiry form. The Garden’s youth program coordinator will then contact you within seven business days. Field trips are not officially booked until you receive a confirmation email and invoice. Guided tours or hands-on classes must be scheduled at least six weeks in advance of your preferred date;
